lineages.label: Emerald Protocol Builder
lineages.visualTheme: acid lime, emerald, jade and earned warm-gold
lineages.lore: Emerald Sprouts believe every moonshot should begin with readable code and a test. They turn degen curiosity into protocols the crew can inspect, simulate, and improve.

lineages.label: Sapphire Chain Courier
lineages.visualTheme: sapphire blue, ice cyan, sky-blue electricity and restrained pink gill warmth
lineages.lore: Sapphire Tides carry signals across pools and chains without losing the receipt. Their speed comes from route discipline, gas awareness, and checking the destination twice.

lineages.label: Amethyst Ghost Crew
lineages.visualTheme: amethyst violet, lilac, magenta starlight and cyan edge glow
lineages.lore: Amethyst Dreams listen where the public timeline goes quiet: wallet trails, pending transactions, and half-formed narratives. They turn ghost signals into evidence without mistaking whispers for proof.

lineages.label: Solar Momentum Racer
lineages.visualTheme: coral orange, warm peach, honey gold and hot-pink speed accents
lineages.lore: Solar Peaches live for candles, volume, and clean momentum, but their racers know that speed without a stop is just exit liquidity wearing goggles.

lineages.label: Rose Signal Riot
lineages.visualTheme: old pink, rose, restrained hot pink, acid-lime signal sparks and cyan counterlight
lineages.lore: Rose Blooms turn memes, raids, and referrals into durable crew energy. Their signal travels through people, so attribution and anti-spam discipline matter as much as reach.

lineages.label: Midnight White-Hat Unit
lineages.visualTheme: pearl charcoal, mint turquoise, pale mint, acid-lime verification light and cyan rim
lineages.lore: Midnight Mints guard the Hatchery from counterfeit contracts, poisoned approvals, and too-good-to-be-true links. White-hat curiosity is their favorite armor.

environment_back.note: Twenty choices: original V4 traits 01-10 plus staged additions 11-20.

pet.note: levels 1-9 unique silhouettes; level 10 universal geometry

small_tool.note: display/pickup slot; not assumed to be in a paw

hud_front.note: V4.1 HUD geometry is matte and perimeter-weighted. Sparse telemetry accents may enter the clear zone; avoid opaque panels over the pet.

platform_mid.drawOrder: after environment_back, before landmark_mid and pet
platform_mid.note: Standing plane aligns to the pet baseline. Front stairs ground the character; later machine and tool layers remain readable above it.

selectionPolicy.note: Scene traits use catalog weights. The pet body is selected by immutable lineage and authoritative Hatchery level, never randomly rolled.

trait.name: Multi-Chain Aurora
trait.description: legendary emerald, cyan, violet and rose aurora ribbons around the perimeter
trait.lore: The aurora appears when several chains corroborate one real narrative. Its rarity reflects how seldom cross-chain evidence agrees cleanly.
trait.degenCulture: multi-chain narrative convergence

trait.name: Clean Scanner Frame
trait.description: matte acid-lime scanner brackets held to the outer edge with compact blockchain nodes and an open center
trait.lore: The scanner frame keeps attention on the contract, pool, and receipt. Minimal UI is the hatchling form of discipline.
trait.degenCulture: clean terminal setups and DYOR checklists

trait.name: Degen Mode Frame
trait.description: matte degen telemetry corners in lime and old-pink with thin hash marks and small edge-only blocks
trait.lore: Degen Mode preserves the energy of the timeline while keeping the center readable. Chaos belongs in the frame, not the verification logic.
trait.degenCulture: full-send aesthetics with bounded risk
trait.toolConnection: rapid market dashboard and safety gates

trait.name: Builder Grid
trait.description: emerald builder-grid corners with modular block nodes, sparse blueprint ticks and a transparent center
trait.lore: The grid turns an idea into modules, tests, and deployable edges. Blueprint ticks never stand in for passing checks.
trait.degenCulture: builder trenches and shipping receipts

trait.name: Courier Route Map
trait.description: sapphire route-map arcs and chain nodes confined to the outer perimeter
trait.lore: Route arcs show each hop and destination contract. A missing endpoint breaks the map instead of being silently guessed.
trait.degenCulture: bridge routes and chain-hopping culture

trait.name: Ghost Signal Overlay
trait.description: subtle amethyst ghost-signal fragments, broken ledger packets and low-opacity edge scans
trait.lore: Ghost arcs reveal wallet traces that ordinary dashboards miss. Broken blocks remain visibly incomplete.
trait.degenCulture: smart-money sleuthing and ghost-wallet lore

trait.name: Momentum Tachometer
trait.description: coral-gold momentum telemetry concentrated along the perimeter with compact restrained ticks
trait.lore: The tachometer pairs speed with a visible risk band. Momentum without liquidity never reaches the redline safely.
trait.degenCulture: candle racing and ATH chasing

trait.name: Community Raid HUD
trait.description: rose community routing nodes with lime pulse accents and small edge clusters
trait.lore: Raid nodes reward distinct humans, not duplicate noise. The burst corners celebrate coordination after the evidence lands.
trait.degenCulture: community raids and meme distribution
trait.toolConnection: crew mission board and anti-sybil receipts

trait.name: Security Lock HUD
trait.description: mint security-verification geometry with compact hash nodes and perimeter lock indicators
trait.lore: The lock frame highlights permissions and verified identities. It protects the pet without pretending any scan is absolute.
trait.degenCulture: white-hat mode and scam-call defense
trait.toolConnection: contract security and wallet permission tools

trait.name: Epoch Competition HUD
trait.description: warm-gold epoch-ring telemetry with cyan chain accents and reduced ornament scale
trait.lore: Competition rings show the frozen epoch window and placement state. Scores outside the receipt set cannot sneak onto the podium.
trait.degenCulture: leaderboard grinding and weekly seasons

trait.name: Awakened Command HUD
trait.description: legendary AXO command perimeter with acid-lime, cyan and restrained rose network geometry
trait.lore: The command HUD unifies routes, security, wallets, markets, and crew evidence at level ten. It is legendary because every panel must agree.
trait.degenCulture: the final degen command-center fantasy
